comment: QEMU configure arguments of the SGI release build. sgi-package.py builds the archives with them and scripts/ci/sgi-check compiles the Windows programs with the same list, so a flag edit is compiled on every pull request. The Linux archive builds with Debian 12's GCC 12, which warns (maybe-uninitialized, in hw/coproc/dsp56300/dsp56300-ops.c) where the pull-request compilers do not, and a release must not stop on a compiler's warnings, and the CHD library's C++ runtime is linked statically so the archive does not need the host's libstdc++. The disabled features keep the archive from depending on what else a build machine has installed.
